subject: QBR prep: headcount triage & backfill playbook
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, lisa@greenfieldrecruit.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: QBR prep: headcount triage & backfill playbook

Team —

As we get materials ready for the Dec QBR, I want to lock down headcount changes that will impact our H1 commitments and OKR delivery. Please treat this as the single source for triage decisions over the next 48 hours. High-level asks: 

- Laura: can you confirm which open reqs have budget codes and which need finance sign-off? I attached a consolidated reqs sheet (reqs_Q1_2027_summary.xlsx) — highlight any mismatch.
- Jonas: please run the prioritization matrix you mentioned on Friday and attach the export (impact, effort, OKR alignment).
- Marissa: CS/Customer-facing risk matrix — which backfills are mission-critical vs deferrable?
- Aditya: include any hiring velocity constraints for managers who we should freeze or accelerate.

I'll propose a freeze on low-impact reqs if we can't get budget sign-off by EOD tomorrow. Recruiting partner (Lisa) — please keep availability for immediate kickoff on approved reqs; mark green the req ids you can mobilize for within two weeks.

I've started a living doc (link below) to capture decisions; we'll bring this to the QBR slides if we finalize by Thursday.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: reqs_Q1_2027_summary.xlsx, backfill_playbook_v1.pdf
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR prep: headcount triage & backfill playbook

Markus — thanks for the clear ask. Quick updates after a pass with Finance: 

- Confirmed budget codes (ready): REQ-2207 (Infra Eng, backfill), REQ-2212 (SRE hire, new), REQ-2228 (Sales AE expansion) — these have committed GL codes.
- Pending sign-off (need written approval): REQ-2234 (Data Scientist, product metrics) — I flagged for incremental headcount; Finance is holding pending clarified deliverables and ROI case.
- No budget: REQ-2249 (Growth PM exploratory) — recommend freeze unless we reclassify as contractor for Q1.

I attached a short note in the backfill_playbook_v1.pdf marking which reqs can move and which need follow-ups. If we freeze REQ-2249, we free up ~$85k of nominal spend for Q1.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 13:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR prep: headcount triage & backfill playbook

Attached: prioritization_matrix_20261201.csv — I scored each req across three axes: OKR alignment (0-5), customer impact (0-5), time-to-value (0-5). Notes: 

- High priority (score 12-15): REQ-2207 (Infra backfill), REQ-2212 (SRE) — both have direct OKR dependency (latency/uptime) and are high TTV.
- Medium priority (8-11): REQ-2228 (Sales AE) — supports expansion OKRs but can be staged in H1 if hiring pace is slow.
- Low priority (<=7): REQ-2249, REQ-2251 (experimental PMs) — recommend freeze and revisit at mid-Q1 after product beta metrics.

Method: scores weighted 40% OKR alignment, 35% customer impact, 25% TTV. I flagged REQ-2234 (Data Scientist) as medium because the ROI case can be strengthened with a 6-week project plan (Laura, happy to pair on that).

Jonas Weber
Director, Strategy & Ops

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR prep: headcount triage & backfill playbook

Adding CS perspective: 

- Backfill REQ-2207 (Infra Eng) is mission-critical — the on-call gap is already causing increased MTTR for two accounts in EU region. Delay will likely delay OKR delivery for reliability.
- REQ-2228 (Sales AE) is important for pipeline coverage but we can stagger hire into late Q1 without major churn. Suggest moving one AE to Q2 and prioritize the other if Finance confirms the GL.
- REQ-2234 (Data Scientist) — if we accept a contractor for the first 10 weeks, we cover the reporting needs for Q1 with lower cost and faster ramp. I cc'd Aditya since hiring velocity for contractors is usually faster.

Short ask: if we freeze any reqs, list them in the doc with an owner for re-evaluation in mid-Q1 (owner + date). I updated the playbook PDF with CS risk annotations.

—Marissa
Customer Success Lead
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR prep: headcount triage & backfill playbook

Thanks all — clear alignment and good work pulling the artifacts together. Final decisions to carry into the QBR slide deck: 

- APPROVE (immediate kickoff): REQ-2207 (Infra Eng backfill), REQ-2212 (SRE) — recruitment to start this week; Lisa, please mobilize shortlist within 10 business days.
- CONDITIONAL APPROVE: REQ-2228 (Sales AE) — proceed with one AE hire in Jan; second AE contingent on hire velocity and Q1 pipeline review.
- FREEZE: REQ-2249 (Growth PM exploratory) and REQ-2251 (Experiment PM) — owners to re-evaluate 2027-02-15 with documented success criteria.
- ALTERNATE PATH: REQ-2234 (Data Scientist) — pilot via contractor for first 10 weeks; Laura, please confirm contractor headcount and cost estimate by Friday EOD.

Action items (owners):
- Laura: finance sign-off paperwork + post-freeze GL reallocation (due Thu EOD).
- Jonas: export final prioritization slide and add scoring notes to the QBR package (due Thu noon).
- Marissa: create risk-owner table for frozen reqs and publish to doc (due Fri).
- Aditya: confirm manager hiring velocity constraints and update recruiting calendar.
- Lisa: mobilize candidates for REQ-2207 and REQ-2212; share shortlists via Slack #recruiting.

I'll fold these items into the QBR slides and circulate a final deck by Friday. Thanks for the quick turnaround — we'll present a concise headcount decision page and the playbook as backup.

Markus Klein
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: prioritization_matrix_20261201.csv, backfill_playbook_v1.pdf, reqs_Q1_2027_summary.xlsx
